slot.brief: Given the focal lengths of objective and eyepiece, find the magnifying power and tube length of an astronomical telescope in normal adjustment.

stem: An astronomical telescope has an objective of focal length $90$ cm and an eyepiece of focal length $6$ cm. In normal adjustment, what are its angular magnification (magnitude) and tube length?

verdicts.working: In normal adjustment, angular magnification = 90/6 = 15 and tube length = 90 + 6 = 96 cm.

working:
$M = \dfrac{f_o}{f_e} = \dfrac{90}{6} = 15$

Independent check: In normal adjustment, angular magnification = 90/6 = 15 and tube length = 90 + 6 = 96 cm.
solution:
In normal adjustment, angular magnification is $M=\dfrac{f_o}{f_e}=\dfrac{90}{6}=15$.
The tube length is $L=f_o+f_e=90+6=96\text{ cm}$.
